method: Full AI editorial semantic reading of every lexical record and all 3900 distinct complete examples (5148 applications), including full English translations, every contextual chunk gloss, full pinyin and word components. Exact Hanzi/pinyin reconstruction checks supplement the reading; they are not presented as semantic proof. Existing sentence corrections were individually read and refined before incorporation.

notes: All occurrences of 教/数/背/转/系/薄 in unique sentences 0..1999 re-read with their complete sentence pinyin. Teaching a skill uses jiāo; counting uses shǔ; a machine rotating uses zhuàn dòng. The existing dictionary entry identity pinyin is preserved.
